SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. B. REGISTRY
328
PASSPORT & REGISTRATION OFFICE. H-O
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL.
P.O. BOX 259.
SHANGHAI.

23rd August, 1940.

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I have received permission to grant of a visa
to Mr. George Pogibin, Stateless Russian, to proceed
to Hongkong for employment in the "Hongkong Hotel Orchestra".

Permission has also been obtained for Mrs. Valeria
Pogibin to accompany her husband. Before granting the
necessary visas I am instructed to satisfy myself as to
their good character and that you have nothing against them.

Mr. and Mrs. Pogibin reside at 265 Avenue Haig,
Apartment 3D. He was born at Habarovsk on the 19th May,
1909 and his wife was born at Vladivostock on the 21st
May, 1914.

I understand that Hamilton Mills at the Cathay knows
the couple as, I think, he brought them round when they made
their original application through me.

Yours sincerely,

R.W. Yorke, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：PA）
（批：From file only R.W.Y. 26/8.）

护照与登记办公室。总部
英国驻上海总领事馆。
邮政信箱 259。
上海。

1940年8月23日。

亲爱的约克先生：

我已获准向无国籍俄国人乔治·波吉宾（George Pogibin）先生签发签证，以便其前往香港，在“香港酒店乐队”任职。

瓦莱里娅·波吉宾（Valeria Pogibin）夫人陪同其丈夫同行的许可也已获批。在签发必要签证之前，我奉命须确认他们品行良好，且贵处对他们并无异议。

波吉宾夫妇居住在海格路265号3D室。他于1909年5月19日出生于哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk），其妻子于1914年5月21日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）。

据我所知，国泰饭店的汉密尔顿·米尔斯（Hamilton Mills）认识这对夫妇，我想，当初他们通过我提交首次申请时，是他带他们来的。

此致

敬礼，

R.W. Yorke 先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注：PA）
（批注：仅摘自档案 R.W.Y. 8月26日。）
